title: The Four Winds
author: Kristin Hannah
summary: In 1930s Texas, drought and dust storms ruin the farms around a woman who has spent her life being told she is plain and unwanted. As the land fails, she makes the hard choice to take her children west to California.
readIf: you want a sweeping historical story of a mother's grit and the Great Depression's human cost.
skipIf: you want a light read, as hunger, exploitation and loss run through it.

pairings.reason: The classic novel of the same migration west, harsher and more political in its voice.
Same author, with another woman's resilience under pressure, set in wartime France instead.
Another epic of people pushing across hard country, with more humour and a bigger cast.
